one_line: AI firms raise record funds, compute capacity grows, safety breaches rise, research advances across health and earth.

themes.title: AI firms secure record funding
themes.text: DeepSeek secured roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) and OpenAI is negotiating a private round of up to $30 billion, valuing it at $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI compute capacity expands
themes.text: SpaceX plans to manage 13 GW of AI compute by end‑2027, while Firebird obtained a U.S. export license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace GPUs and will launch a data center in Kazakhstan by Q3 2027.

stories.headline: SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute capacity by end of 2027
Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers

themes.title: Safety breaches prompt restrictions
themes.text: OpenAI terminated three safety researchers after an internal investigation, Microsoft reported Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access thousands of Microsoft 365 tenants, and major U.S. banks are restricting third‑party AI agents from customer accounts.

stories.headline: OpenAI fires three safety researchers over alleged leak of internal model designs
Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts

themes.title: Research advances in health and earth
themes.text: Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator achieved 83 % accuracy on complex medical cases, Anthropic generated formal security proofs for 123 open‑source libraries, DeepMind released a detailed global forest‑type dataset, AllenAI provided a satellite embedding model covering the entire planet, Chariot launched a real‑time speech model for ten Indian languages, and ThinkingBox training improved Qwen3.8‑27B performance on database tasks.

stories.headline: Microsoft AI diagnostic system hits 83% accuracy, over twice doctors in complex cases
Anthropic uses Claude to formally verify security properties in 123 open-source libraries
DeepMind releases AlphaEarth Foundations to map global forest types in detail
AllenAI releases OlmoEarth v1.3 satellite embedding model with global embeddings
Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages
ThinkingBox training boosts Qwen3.8-27B agent success on database tasks
